verdict.rationale: The New York Department of Taxation and Finance offers a government tax portal and online services: filing, payments, and responding to notices. It is not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client and use tools from plugged-in servers, so this story's axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI-assistant or tool-consuming capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
